confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are the most reliable; hostel and hotel rates vary widely by location and season (July assumed to be rainy-season demand). Cocktail and wine anchors are scaled from the beer anchor (about 3 to 3.3 times) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX rate comes from search-result excerpts of the RBA Exchange Rates Overview and was not re-read from the live page, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southeast Asian capital and tourist-city price levels (for example Siem Reap and Hanoi), adjusted for Phnom Penh's largely USD-priced tourist sector. Web search was used only for the RBA FX observation, not for city prices.

anchor_basis.beer: Angkor draft beer, about 330 ml glass at a mid-level restaurant, about 6,000 riel.
anchor_basis.coffee: Cappuccino at a mid-range cafe, about 10,000 riel.
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: Bai sach chrouk (grilled pork with rice) at a local eatery, about 14,000 riel.
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: Two starters, two Khmer mains such as fish amok, and two desserts at a mid-range restaurant, about 120,000 riel total.
anchor_basis.cocktail: Mojito or similar standard cocktail at a riverside bar, about 18,000 riel.
anchor_basis.wine_glass: House red wine by the glass at a mid-range restaurant, about 20,000 riel.
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: Bed in a six-bed mixed dorm at a central registered hostel, about 6 USD per night.
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: Private double room with fan or AC at a central registered hostel, about 18 USD per night.
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: Basic double room with fan and private bathroom at a registered guesthouse, about 14 USD per night.
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: Standard double room at a registered three-star hotel, about 60 USD per night.
